categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Changhai Composite Materials Co., Ltd primarily operates in the production and sales of glass fiber, glass fiber products, and glass fiber composite materials. The company also engages in the research, development, and sales of chemical products including unsaturated polyester resin, vinyl ester resin, and other fine chemical products through its subsidiary Tianma Group. Its product portfolio includes glass fiber yarn, chopped strand mat, wet-laid mat, glass fiber fabrics, composite separators, coated mats, and thermoplastic glass fiber products, serving various industries such as construction materials, rail transit, petrochemicals, automotive manufacturing, electronics, and new energy.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes high-temperature melting, fiber drawing, roving, and weaving processes to produce glass fiber and related products. It has developed advanced technologies including intelligent manufacturing for high-performance glass fiber, automated and intelligent equipment for composite materials processing, and proprietary processes for low moisture content wet yarn and high wet strength glass fiber mats. The company holds numerous patents and leads in the development of high-modulus glass fiber and specialized chopped strand mats, with a focus on green, intelligent, and high-end product innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's key customers span strategic foundational industries such as construction materials, rail transit, petrochemicals, automotive manufacturing, electronics, and new energy sectors. Its products are sold domestically across over 30 provinces and exported to more than 30 countries and regions including North America, South America, Europe, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Oceania, and Africa. The company serves both domestic and international markets with a significant portion of revenue derived from domestic sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: Jiangsu Changhai Composite Materials operates primarily in China, with production facilities concentrated in the eastern coastal regions such as Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and Guangdong provinces. The company also maintains a stable overseas market presence with exports to North America, South America, Europe, Middle East, Southeast Asia, Oceania, and Africa. Its international trade is mainly settled in US dollars, and it actively participates in global composite material exhibitions to expand its global footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates a vertically integrated supply chain encompassing upstream glass fiber production, midstream glass fiber product deep processing, and downstream composite material manufacturing. It controls key stages from raw material processing to finished composite products, enabling cost control, quality assurance, and rapid response to market demands. Its subsidiary Tianma Group extends the supply chain horizontally by producing chemical resins and related materials essential for composite manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and R&D to enhance product performance and expand application fields. It invests significantly in R&D, focusing on developing high-performance glass fiber products, lightweight materials for automotive applications, wind power blade materials, and environmentally friendly resins. The company aims to advance green manufacturing, digital transformation, and intelligent production, aligning with national carbon neutrality goals and industry trends towards high-end, green, and smart composites.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of glass fiber, glass fiber products, composite materials, and chemical products. The company employs a sales model combining direct sales and distributor channels domestically, and an 'agent plus exhibition' model for international sales. Payment methods include letters of credit, telegraphic transfers, and documentary collections, with pricing strategies adjusted based on market conditions and currency fluctuations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiangsu Changhai Composite Materials is one of the largest integrated producers of nonwoven glass fiber products in China and a leading high-tech enterprise in the glass fiber composite materials sector. The industry is highly concentrated with oligopolistic competition, and the company maintains a leading position in the chopped strand mat and wet-laid mat segments. It competes on scale, technology, product quality, and cost control against domestic and international glass fiber manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.66 billion, representing a 2.1% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 274.8 million, a decrease of 7.2%. Total assets reached RMB 7.12 billion, up 12.77% year-on-year, reflecting significant capacity expansion and capital investment. The company’s R&D expenditure was RMB 132.8 million, accounting for 4.99% of revenue, underscoring its commitment to innovation despite market challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its complete vertical integration in the glass fiber industry chain, enabling superior control over product quality, cost efficiency, and rapid innovation cycles. It differentiates itself through advanced manufacturing technologies, a broad and high-performance product portfolio, and strong R&D capabilities. Its products offer high strength, lightweight, corrosion resistance, thermal insulation, and electrical insulation, catering to strategic industries with growing demand for sustainable and high-performance composite materials.
